newsitem.title: UK: Thin Russia trade waits on Eurobond pricing.
newsitem.headline: Thin Russia trade waits on Eurobond pricing.

text.p: Russian MinFins and Vneshekonombank debt were mixed to weaker in thin mid-morning trade after they were marked up at the start of the day.
"Trading is very thin, it is not surprising to see some weakness as the pricing emerges," said a trader.
Talk in New York overnight was that the eurobond issue size could be as much as $750 million compared with a planned $500 million.
Russian MinFins 4s had been up as much as 1/2 a point in early trade but came off to down 1/8 at 60 bid. Dollar Vnesh RUVNUSLNS=RR was was around unchanged from its New York close at 79 5/8 bid.

Bank of America analyst Richard Gray recommended investors swtich from Russian MinFin 3s and 5s in to MinFin 4s RU3E03=RR to get an instrument which was closer to the duration of the five-year eurobond.
Russia also announced it would complete a review of frozen MinFins within a month and release frozen bonds acquired in good faith.
"This has been in the price for some time but it looks as if it will not be resolved before the eurobond, although investors seem quite happy with the new issue," said a trader.
Elswehere in the market, prices were weaker to steady in largely inactive trade. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
